item.description:
Hangly 2.3.1

  • Messi joins Football Legends. Holding the number ten up to the crowd.
  • One rope through every charm. With two or three charms, the rope runs unbroken from charm to charm however hard they swing, and only the top charm wears beads.
  • Charms hang like real pendants. The rope meets each charm at its top or its ring, straight above it, and beads stay on the rope and clear of the charm.
  • Lift a charm and the rope reels in. No more folded or vanishing rope when you hold a charm up near the top of the screen.

Hangly 2.3

  • Realistic ropes and chains. Every rope is drawn from real thread, leather, silk and metal, and chains hang a charm by their own last link.
  • Charms hang from their own rings. No gaps: the rope meets every charm, and ringed charms hang from a tiny jump ring.
  • Update in Background. When a new version is out, a card under the charm says what is new; one press and Hangly updates and restarts by itself.
  • News from the charm. New charms and collections pop up in glass under your charm, swing with it, and leave on their own.
  • A smoother Library, and a glow that takes each charm's own shape.
